# CouponPush

> CouponPush helps shoppers discover coupon codes, promotional offers and online deals, with an India-focused shopping context.

Use the linked merchant pages for current offer details. Availability, prices and eligibility are determined by the merchant and can change. A listed offer is not proof of a successful checkout. Distinguish codes from no-code deals, immediate discounts from future rewards, and confirmed terms from unknown conditions.

## Site guide

- [Detailed site context](https://couponpush.com/llms-full.txt): Plain-text guide to page types, offer interpretation and disclosures.
- [Home](https://couponpush.com/): Main shopping entry point.
- [Stores](https://couponpush.com/stores/): Merchant directory and links to store offer pages.
- [Categories](https://couponpush.com/categories/): Browse offers by shopping category.
- [Deals](https://couponpush.com/deals/): Browse deals.
- [All coupons](https://couponpush.com/coupons/): Browse coupon codes and deals with store, category and offer-type filters.
- [Offers](https://couponpush.com/offers/): Browse promotional offers.

## Merchant pages

- [Foxtale](https://couponpush.com/store/foxtale/): Foxtale offers and listed conditions.
- [Cetaphil](https://couponpush.com/store/cetaphil-coupon-code/): Cetaphil offers; check whether an entry requires a code.
- [Dot & Key](https://couponpush.com/store/dot-key/): Dot & Key offers.
- [The Derma Co](https://couponpush.com/store/the-derma-co/): The Derma Co offers.
- [Minimalist](https://couponpush.com/store/minimalist/): Minimalist offers.
- [Plum](https://couponpush.com/store/plum/): Plum offers.
